distinctions.claim: High and low are the day's high and low fields
Close is the day's closing-price field
Liquid equity-derivative futures closing price uses a last-half-hour weighted average
Illiquid unexpired futures can have a theoretical settlement price
ClsPric must always lie inside LwPric and HghPric when TtlTradgVol is nonzero
All trade states contributing to total volume also contribute identically to high, low, open, and close
Zero-volume bhavcopy prices are carry-forward values
The MII XpryDt numeric value uses the Unix epoch
